================================================================================
heredoc basic
================================================================================

locals {
  x = <<EOF
hello world
EOF
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (heredoc_template
              (heredoc_identifier)
              (heredoc_identifier))))))))

================================================================================
heredoc with interpolation
================================================================================

locals {
  x = <<EOF
Hello, ${var.name}!
EOF
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (heredoc_template
              (heredoc_identifier)
              (template_interpolation
                (expression
                  (expression
                    (variable_expr
                      (identifier)))
                  (get_attr
                    name: (identifier))))
              (heredoc_identifier))))))))

================================================================================
indented heredoc
================================================================================

locals {
  x = <<-EOF
    hello
  EOF
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (heredoc_template
              (heredoc_identifier)
              (heredoc_identifier))))))))

================================================================================
string with escape sequence
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "line1\nline2"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template)))))))

================================================================================
string with dollar escape
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "cost is $${amount}"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template)))))))

================================================================================
template if directive
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "%{if var.enabled}yes%{endif}"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template
              (template_directive
                (template_if
                  condition: (expression
                    (expression
                      (variable_expr
                        (identifier)))
                    (get_attr
                      name: (identifier))))))))))))

================================================================================
template if-else directive
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "%{if var.enabled}yes%{else}no%{endif}"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template
              (template_directive
                (template_if
                  condition: (expression
                    (expression
                      (variable_expr
                        (identifier)))
                    (get_attr
                      name: (identifier))))))))))))
